note: Raw input, read-only after download. Excluded from git; this manifest is committed in its place.
publisher: Central Statistics Office (Ireland), from matched BER and ESB Networks meter data
title: Household Electricity Consumption by type of dwelling, period of construction and year (DBEREL02)
used_for: The held-out half of the device-layer check. DBEREL01 (dwelling x BER) is what the trigger rates were tuned against, so it cannot also measure whether they generalise. DBEREL02 crosses dwelling type with PERIOD OF CONSTRUCTION instead, a dimension the tuning never saw, and D02 already carries year_built_band, so it scores the same homes on an axis that was not fitted. Exposure stays 'none' and must stay 'none'.
